name: Users - Authorized - External Email Suffixes [ends with]
description: Intent: Authorized external email-recipient suffixes — populate with vetted partner / customer / vendor email domains (e.g., @partner-co.com, @bigcustomer.com, @auditor-firm.com). Drives the Authorized External Email direction on D-series email and M3020 / W3000 / B3000 segmentation. Exclusions: do not add personal email domains (gmail.com, yahoo.com, outlook.com) — those are caught by the [CH] Personal Email Domains list and intentionally route to the Unauthorized warn/block path; do not add untrusted free providers.
